segments.text: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

footnotes.text: + What shall be given…: or, What shall the deceitful tongue give unto thee? or, what shall is profit thee?

segments.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

footnotes.text: + Sharp…: or, It is as the sharp arrows of the mighty man, with coals of juniper

segments.text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

segments.speaker: Psalmist
segments.text: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

footnotes.text: + for peace: or, a man of peace
